comment: Axis axis does not occur in Great Nicobar; introduced only to Andamans.
Sambar is a mainland cervid completely absent from the Nicobar archipelago.
Felis chaus (Jungle Cat) is absent from Great Nicobar; no wild felids exist on the island.
Northern Palm Squirrel is a mainland species with zero native or introduced records on GNI.
Barking deer is completely absent from Great Nicobar; desk-copied mainland record.
Table cites outdated IUCN category VU; officially uprated to Endangered (EN).
Genuine endemic to GNI; flagged due to GBIF sampling sparsity around southern coastal coordinates.
